essence: After placing in reverse order with seed syllables, one should perform the body installation.
The seed of these five, beginning with satya, is declared to be endowed with short vowels.
The placement should proceed in order from the thumb to the little finger.
One should then place the five kāmas in the arrow places.
The limb ritual action of the mantra is performed with the first seed joined with six long vowels.
